purpose: Exercise the post-fix stochastic history-matching path, establish new baseline fit diagnostics, identify binding targets, and measure sensitivity to V_disc without claiming a final calibrated ensemble.
limitations: This is one 1000-point wave in a 32-dimensional space, so absence of NROY is diagnostic rather than proof that the full prior box is empty.
The selected 1975 calibration space retains its diagnostic seed bounds; the wider union bounds recommended by B-1/B-2 are deferred until the final production-space decision.
The 1975 base configuration retains the documented limitation that period-specific demographic inputs for 1975-1980 are not separately validated.
No output from this run may be called a posterior, credible interval, or final calibration ensemble.

rationale.max_waves: One bounded learning wave only; no automatic continuation overnight.
rationale.min_volume_shrinkage: Retained for compatibility with the production loop but inactive in a one-wave run.
rationale.min_nroy_members: Fewer than 10 survivors is too sparse to support a downstream ensemble and must be reviewed.

discrepancy.rationale: Primary for this learning wave because it is the already documented Andrianakis et al. illustrative rule. It is not adopted as the final scientific choice.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: target_relative_10pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: A one-sigma model-discrepancy allowance equal to 10% of each observed target. Scored on the same simulations and never used to rescue or continue the primary wave.

scored_years_rationale: Nineteen prespecified trajectory anchors: the entire non-overlapping ECDC HIV window, seven SHM MSM diagnosis anchors spanning its observed period, and six AIDS-case anchors spanning the historical peak and decline. This avoids treating every serially correlated annual count as an independent maximum-rule constraint.

waves.comment: All nineteen primary anchors enter the single learning wave. Total SHM diagnoses are excluded because C-1 makes their residual exactly collinear with MSM diagnoses and partly input-driven.

run_settings.note: Each parameter point is scored on the mean of stochastic seeds 91000-91002. The same seeds are used at every point for common-random-number stability. A-5 per-run V_ensemble is divided by 3 in the variance budget.
